purpose: Review these problems, Goodie actions, solutions and similar concepts before creating another image. Changing a character, prop or wording does not make the underlying story new.

image1.title: Compulsive scrolling
image1.problem: A man loses time in an endless social-media wheel.
image1.goodie_actions: Shows a postcard reminding him that his time is valuable.
image1.solutions: He repairs a motorcycle with an older neighbor.
image1.principle: Leave passive consumption for useful real-world activity
image1.review_basis: Visual inspection of the actual image

image2.title: Appearance pressure
image2.problem: A woman worries that makeup and a perfect appearance are necessary for love.
image2.goodie_actions: Shows her a reminder while her dogs look on.
image2.solutions: She relaxes outside and enjoys her dogs without performing perfection.
image2.review_basis: Visual inspection of the actual image

image3.title: Destructive strength
image3.problem: A giant angry man stomps through a damaged street.
image3.goodie_actions: Offers a tiny glowing heart and a reminder that strong people need love.
image3.solutions: He gently holds the heart and supports a young tree.
image3.principle: Turn intimidating strength into gentle care
image3.review_basis: Visual inspection of the actual image

image4.title: Buying happiness
image4.problem: A man considers an expensive sports car beneath a promise to buy happiness.
image4.goodie_actions: Points to a postcard and the people enjoying one another nearby.
image4.solutions: He joins neighbors playing with a paper boat in the rain.
image4.message: Some good things have no price.
image4.principle: Choose shared low-cost joy over a status purchase
image4.review_basis: Visual inspection of the actual image

image5.title: Lonely dinner
image5.problem: An older man eats alone beside an empty chair.
image5.goodie_actions: Shows him a postcard and an open doorway to a communal meal.
image5.solutions: He joins neighbors at their table and shares bread.
image5.review_basis: Visual inspection of the actual image

image6.title: Achievement-dependent happiness
image6.problem: A father polishes trophies while his child waits with a cardboard box.
image6.goodie_actions: Reminds him he does not have to earn every happy moment.
image6.solutions: He and his child play in a cardboard spaceship, with Goodie laughing beside them.
image6.message: You don’t have to earn every happy moment.
image6.principle: Set achievement aside for imaginative play
image6.review_basis: Visual inspection of the actual image

image7.title: Baking perfectionism
image7.problem: A baker measures identical cupcakes and rejects imperfect results.
image7.solutions: He decorates funny irregular animal cupcakes with children.
image7.principle: Choose playful making over flawless output
image7.review_basis: Visual inspection of the actual image

image8.title: Online approval

image8.principle: Replace audience approval with direct companionship
image8.review_basis: Visual inspection of the actual image

image9.title: Caregiver depletion

image9.solutions: She rests under a blanket while her family brings tea and comfort.
image9.message: Let someone care for you, too.
image9.principle: Allow others to care for the caregiver
image9.review_basis: Visual inspection of the actual image

image10.title: Performance anxiety

image10.message: Joy doesn’t need a perfect performance.

image10.review_basis: Visual inspection of the actual image

image11.review_basis: Visual inspection of the actual image

image12.principle: Choose messy participation over spotless control
image12.review_basis: Visual inspection of the actual image

image21.title: Winning as self-worth

image22.title: Size of success

image22.goodie_actions: Shows a reminder that a good day is not measured by size.

image23.title: Important work crowds out a child

image24.title: Purchasing peace

image25.title: Strength mistaken for isolation

image26.title: Capturing instead of experiencing

image26.goodie_actions: Shows a postcard questioning the effort to preserve every moment.
image26.solutions: He leaves cameras on a dry towel and runs barefoot into the sea in his clothes.
image26.message: You can miss a moment while trying to keep it.
image26.principle: Set recording equipment aside and experience the moment
image26.review_basis: Visual inspection of the actual image

image27.title: Anxiety about beginning
image27.problem: A woman faces a long staircase disappearing into darkness.
image27.goodie_actions: Lights only the first step and shows the short message This one.
image27.solutions: She takes that first illuminated step while the rest remains dark.
image27.principle: Take a manageable first step without seeing the whole route
image27.review_basis: Visual inspection of the actual image

image28.title: Invisible night work
image28.problem: An exhausted baker leaves his bakery after a night shift.
image28.goodie_actions: Shows the postcard Because of you.
image28.solutions: He notices neighbors enjoying the bread he made and recognizes his contribution.
image28.principle: See the real people reached by unseen work
image28.review_basis: Visual inspection of the actual image

image29.title: Intimidation versus consideration

image29.solutions: He solemnly stops traffic for an enormous duck procession while Goodie laughs.

image29.review_basis: Visual inspection of the actual image

image30.title: Understaffed care
image30.problem: A night nurse faces a ward sign showing many residents and very few carers.
image30.goodie_actions: Presses the heart button as additional staff appear and displays a caring-hands message.
image30.solutions: With colleagues sharing the work, she has time for attentive bedside care and staff breaks.
image30.message: Care needs caring hands. / Now there’s time to care.
image30.principle: Share an excessive workload through adequate staffing
image30.review_basis: Visual inspection of the actual image

image31.title: Distressing news overload

image31.goodie_actions: Presses the heart button; the news television becomes a little wheeled set heading toward an Enough for Today bin.
image31.solutions: She enjoys tea and conversation with a neighbor outside.
image31.message: The world outside is still here.

image31.review_basis: Visual inspection of the actual image

image32.title: More presents without wonder

image32.solutions: Children and family explore experiments, building, puzzles and books together.

image32.review_basis: Visual inspection of the actual image

image33.title: A postponed family visit

image33.goodie_actions: Presses the heart button and reminds a younger relative there is still time to make another memory.

image33.review_basis: Visual inspection of the actual image

image34.title: Excess luxury versus useful capacity

image35.title: Leaving a mess for others

image35.solutions: He returns and mops up his spill as the cleaner looks relieved.

image35.principle: Take responsibility for the mess you created
image35.review_basis: Visual inspection of the actual image

image36.title: Taking more than a share

image36.review_basis: Visual inspection of the actual image

image37.title: Leaving gym equipment out

image40.title: Taking sole credit

image41.title: Buying status to feel sufficient

image41.review_basis: Visual inspection of the actual image

image44.title: Strong but afraid to ask

image44.review_basis: Visual inspection of the actual image
